jty-sat-1.webp.zh: 在卫星图上，阿斯提帕莱阿机场（JTY）与周围的水域与海岸连成一片。
jty-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, Astypalaia Airport (JTY) blends into the surrounding water and coastline.

jty-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 白色平顶候机楼沿砾石场坪展开，圆角塔台立在右端，楼前停着蓝白两色的行李拖车。
jty-chatgpt-01.webp.en: A white flat-roofed terminal runs along the gravel forecourt, a rounded tower block at its right end and baggage carts parked in front.

jty-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 暮色里，跑道与滑行道的弧线绕过一片低矮的白色航站楼，前方是平静的海面。
jty-chatgpt-02.webp.en: At dusk the runway and taxiway curves sweep past a low white terminal, with calm sea and a dark headland beyond.

jty-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 旅客举着登机牌和护照站在机坪上，身后是一架停着的双发涡桨飞机。
jty-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A traveller holds up boarding passes and a passport on the apron, a twin turboprop parked behind in the low sun.

jty-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 黄色弧线绕过空荡的机坪，白色候机楼与角楼上的塔台在晴空下显得小巧。
jty-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A yellow arc curves across the empty apron toward a small white terminal, its control-tower cab set on the corner under a clear sky.

jty-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 航拍视角下，一条跑道铺在伸入深蓝海面的岬角上，航站楼挤在跑道中段一侧。
jty-chatgpt-05.webp.en: From the air a single runway lies along a peninsula jutting into deep blue water, with the terminal squeezed alongside its middle.
